summary: Cango Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting results of an extraordinary general meeting (EGM) held June 24, 2026. Shareholders approved a share consolidation at a ratio up to 10:1, with no fractional shares issued, and adoption of amended articles to reflect the consolidation. The board retains discretion to implement within 15 days of the EGM. This is a routine capital-structure adjustment, not a special situation; no terms such as price or premium apply. The US-equivalent filing is a Form 6-K. What to watch: whether the board proceeds and the final ratio.
